ideas.title: Uncovering Police Brutality in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate the pattern of police brutality in Minnesota, including the killing of Alex Pretti and the subsequent federal civil rights investigation.
questions: What are the circumstances surrounding the killing of Alex Pretti?
How widespread is police brutality in Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover systemic issues with police brutality and racial injustice in Minnesota. I recommend investigating further to expose any wrongdoing and hold those responsible accountable.
